title: Compare forward and Viterbi results
description: You build a random hidden Markov model and compare sequence likelihood with best-path probability.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You sample a matrix and divide each row by its sum. Each returned row therefore represents a probability distribution.
You construct transition matrix A, emission matrix B, and initial distribution pi. The state and observation names follow their integer indices.
You create a three-state, four-observation model using seed 7. Both algorithms receive the supplied observation sequence.

steps.question: Which recorded log value is larger: the forward likelihood or the Viterbi best-path probability?
steps.answer: The forward value is larger than the Viterbi value. Forward combines path contributions, while Viterbi selects one best path.

steps.description: You print the decoded path alongside both log values. Each decoded entry corresponds to one observation position.
